decision: reject; preserve untouched raw source only

visual_review.palette_and_costume: Skin reads orange/bronze and too light versus accepted Briar references. Trainers are russet/red-dominant rather than cream-dominant. Jersey/chest is blank and wrists bare.
visual_review.ball: No ball or prop is present.
visual_review.transparency_and_margins: Raw alpha>=1 bounds are [97,126,1240,1206] on 1254x1254, so faint residue approaches the right edge (14px). Figure alpha>=8 bounds are [419,246,909,877]; top margin is 19.62%, below the required 25%. The raw source fails the 25%-clear requirement on every edge.
visual_review.cell_margins: Single-figure source only; 25% alpha-zero canvas clearance fails and must not be normalized or cleaned into acceptance.
visual_review.overall: Reject. Preserve source byte-for-byte; no cleanup, placement normalization, packing, or production registration.
